capabilities: Scan a mounted KOReader device for .sdr metadata directories
Parse Lua-serialized annotations into highlights and notes
Generate one Markdown note per book from a Nunjucks template
Import all books or select specific ones via fuzzy search
Sanitize filenames and overwrite or skip notes on re-import
extras: The manifest carries the community-plugin notice that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is also documented via BRAT and manual file copy.
problem: Obsidian has no way to read the .sdr annotation files a KOReader e-reader stores locally, so highlights must be copied by hand.

relations.evidence: Import highlights and notes from KOReader into your Obsidian vault.

summary: Imports KOReader e-reader highlights and notes into the vault as one Markdown note per book, with customizable Nunjucks templates.
